scope: Existing Official Package durable checks against Wasm and native execution. Test assertions were unchanged. These checks are separate from the exact Core frame comparison and performance measurements.
notes: The initial reference and native runs stopped deliberately at test boundaries. Their command termination statuses remain in the batch records.
The reference parallel batch had 27 failures. Serial rechecks on a clean checkout, with the required comparison Collection configured, all passed.
The native parallel batch had one timing-sensitive Transfer failure. Its serial recheck passed. The failed attempt remains in the batch record.

Two lifecycle cases append a Wasm custom section and publish the new program hash without changing the native manifest. The expected unmatched-program path selects Wasm. Both gameplay checks passed, but the strict native-only evidence audit correctly refused to count them as fully native.
The broad Package suite used the earlier runtime artifact identified by its hash. Final runtime Gateway and Headless Client checks are recorded separately.
Manifest hashes identify the supplied artifact pair. Source revisions and dirty flags are per batch; these runs are not one clean-checkout comparison.
